title: Rank Reward Candidates by Rollout Evidence
summary: Select a trained candidate using held-out task behavior, not the numerical scale of its training reward.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Reward contributions and independent progress/success metrics are dimensionless and already normalized.

physical_contract.axes: Batch, rollout, time and component axes are defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Observations are recorded rollout steps; paired comparisons share seed identity by column. No coordinate transform or simulator execution is implicit.
physical_contract.batching: Batch, rollout, time and component axes are defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Original bounded reward-design diagnostic or arithmetic teaching language. It does not reproduce language-model search, policy training or real-robot transfer.
